<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def sq_positions(frame):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='S':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
before=sq_positions(current_frame)
print('before RIGHT:',before)
res=action(['RIGHT'])
after=sq_positions(current_frame)
print('after RIGHT:',after)
print('board_changed',res.get('board_changed'),'step',current_frame.step)
for b,a2 in zip(before,after):
    print('  sq',b,'->',a2,'dr',a2[0]-b[0],'dc',a2[1]-b[1])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def sq_positions(frame):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='S':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
before=sq_positions(current_frame)
print('before RIGHT:',before)
res=action(['RIGHT'])
after=sq_positions(current_frame)
print('after RIGHT:',after)
print('board_changed',res.get('board_changed'),'step',current_frame.step)
for b,a2 in zip(before,after):
    print('  sq',b,'->',a2,'dr',a2[0]-b[0],'dc',a2[1]-b[1])
